plugins.Name: Time Memoria
plugins.Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
plugins.Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
plugins.Changelog:
New window:
- /tmwiki opens a small window that lists every quest in your journal. Click a quest to open its page on the FFXIV wiki.
- The quests are grouped by expansion, then by the place headings that the journal uses.
- Click an expansion heading to open the Main Scenario Quests page for that expansion. If you have an MSQ accepted in that expansion, the heading opens the page for the story arc of that quest (for example, Post-Shadowbringers).
- /tmwiki always uses the classic window, also when you chose the Native window in Settings.

Wiki search:
- Some quest names in the game data start with an icon character. The wiki search now removes that character, so the search goes directly to the quest page.
